title: The Rebellion and Persecution of the Contemptible Man
description: A contemptible man arises and seizes the kingdom by cunning. He overwhelms overflowing armies and the prince of the covenant, and turns his heart against the holy covenant. His forces desecrate the sanctuary, abolish the daily sacrifice, and set up the abomination that causes desolation. Those who sin against the covenant are seduced into apostasy, but those who know their God stand firm. The wise among the people fall by sword and flame to be refined until the end time. The king exalts himself above every god and speaks unheard things against the God of gods. In the end time he marches south, takes the beautiful land and Egypt, but rumors from east and north terrify him. He pitches his tents between the sea and the holy mountain, yet meets his end with no help.
